Pom, who is it? A visitor?
Oh, it's been a year, right?\nThe wormhole to another world must have opened!
Hey, where did you come from?\n...So, you came from another world! Yay!\nWe have a guest for the first time in a year!!
Oh, right. You strayed into here and you know\nnothing about here.
Okay, listen. A wormhole that leads to another\nworld opens once a year. We've never seen what\nthe world is like but...
We didn't have any guest last year.\nI felt so lonely, pom...
I was worried if people come this year.\nBut now, you're here! I'm so happy!
So...
So... Trick or Treat!!
Tee hee hee. Sorry.\nOnce you enter here and get [Trick or Treat]\ncurse from us...
You must collect the sweets that we want.\nOtherwise...
Horrible tricks will fall on you, pom!
Don't be scared like that.\nFetch the sweets and we'll remove your curses♪
...What? What kind of curse, you ask?\nWell, mine is the earth cracks and you fall into\nthe fissure...
Mine is, you get involved with a fire accident\ncaused by spurt of flame.
Mine, you get trampled down by a huge Potum\nthat appears all of a sudden!
I have to do it, then...
It's a pain but...
I'll collect the sweets.
Yeah!!
So, whose sweets are you gonna collect first?
We want different sweets and more than one kind\nof sweet.
So, ask each and go collect the sweets, pom♪
Hey! Who are you gonna choose first?\nWe can't wait!
You got cursed(?) by them...\nYou need to collect [ffff64]sweets[ffffff] to cure the curses...
The guest from another world! Thanks for\ncompleting our requests. It's not much but\nhere's our token of appreciation!
Trrrriiiick orrrr Trrrrreaaat!!
Ouch ouch...
H-How did you like it?\nWas a sort of thrilling attraction, right?
We... just wanted you to have fun in return for\ncollecting the sweets, you know. Ha ha...
It was obviously far from an attraction...
H-Here you are! This is the true reward for you.\nYou won't be able to visit here often but\nI hope you can come again and play with us!
I miss you...
Take care, pom!
...Um, I got it.\nWe'll stop that attraction.\nIt's too dangerous, yes...
Heh!
Difficulty: Normal has been added to\nBOSS: Pumpking.
Oh, the same guest again, pom?
Oh, I've seen the guest before.\nIt's been a year already?
No way, idiot.\nYou went back to your world, didn't ya?
...Aha. You really like the things others don't.\nWell, I kinda like it.\nThen, we want you to collect the sweets again.
No worries.\nWe won't curse you again.
We promise.
If you get the sweets for us, we'll give you\nsomething great, pom.
You're not in a hurry. Let's accept it...
Yeah!!
So, whose sweets are you gonna collect first?
You've really been a great help for collecting\nthe sweets. Soon, the wormhole will close, so\nwe'll give you some extra reward!
Show me the three gifts that we gave you in\nreturn for collecting the sweets, please?
Now, thanks to these items and sweets that you've\ncollected, we gained more power! Yea!!
Trrrriiiick orrrr Trrrrreaaat!!
Now you can fight Pumpking (Lv100)!\n[ffff64]The difficulty is really high, so we recommend\nthat you challenge forming a party![ffffff]
Ouchch... Something is wrong.\nWe became stronger, didn't we...?
N-No, no. As I said, it's an attraction.\nYou know, an amusement!\nWe'll get separated soon, so...
...A-And you've collected the sweets before, so\nit was pretty easy, wasn't it?
S-So, we just wanted you to get excited so you\nwon't get bored. A ha ha...
It was more like life-threatening...
H-Here you are! This is the true reward for you.\nCome again and collect the sweets, enjoy the\nattraction!
I miss you...
Take care, pom!
What? Um, ah. Yes. We'll be good.\nWe'll think about another safe and enjoyable\nattraction...
Who wants to be good, huh?!\nHeh!!
HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Pumpking!!
[ff6464]No! I'm falling! Nooooo!!![ffffff]
[ff6464]Halloween Event ended.[ffffff]
Difficulty: Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Pumpking.
Difficulty: Very Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Pumpking.
Hey, you've been to here before, right?\n...Yea! You're the guest from another world!\nWhoa! It's been a while!!
Olant and Potumkin? Yea, they were here until\nthe gate to another world opened but when it\nopened, huge hands flew to here and...
They were caught by the hands.\nCan you see the castle?\nThey were kidnapped to there...
There's a horrible witch in the castle and\nshe's said to change people like us into\nsweets and eat them.
They could be changed into sweets...\nI must hurry but there's nothing I can do alone...
You had a tough time because of their prank last\ntime but you can't stand and watch them being\neaten by the witch...
What?! You can help me rescue them?!\nThank you! Now, let's go to the castle, shall we?
*pant* *pant*\nWe... We managed slip through their fingers...
*pant* *pant* *pant*\nI thought I would be... mashed by the huge hands...
But I feel frustrated... We were caught in a cage\nand then we were almost swatted like mosquitoes...\nI wanna beat her this time...
I'm sure we could win if we were able to become\nPumpking...
That's right... Hm? Pumpking?\n...Oh, right! Let's just become Pumpking!!
What...?
Oh yea!!
TRICK OR TREEEEAAAAT!!
We're sorry.\nWe wanna have our revenge so bad...
So, please [ffff64]collect sweets[ffffff] for us.
I apologize for casting the curse on you.\nI know you won't run from us but...
We can't fail to take revenge on the witch, so\nwe definitely need you to collect sweets.\nThe curse is a kind of insurance...
We didn't want to do this to you cuz you helped me.\nBut we want to beat the witch at any cost!
Please, pom.\nI want you to collect sweets.
How could you say no after hearing this...\nWhat is more, you need to break the curse...
Yaaay!!
Thank you so much! Then, collect the sweets written\ndown here. The number is less than the last time.
You got it?Thanks in advance.
We'll be happy if you could collect 'em as soon as\npossible.
Watch your step, pom.
Hey! How did it go? You've collected sweets?\n...Awww, not yet? It's not so hard, right?\nMeh.
We wanna avenge ourselves against the witch now.\nWe can't do that without sweets.\nSo, please hurry. Okay?
Thanks for saving us earlier.\nI was scared to death while I was being confined.\nI can't forgive her for what she has done to me!
There would be nothing to be scared of after\nbecoming the Pumpking. So, I want you to get\nsweets asap. Thanks in advance.
I'm so mad right now, pom!\nThe witch tried to turn us into sweets and\nswat us like mosquitoes! That's ridiculous!
We are cute and harmless, however, she has crossed\nthe line!! She must pay for this after we transform\ninto the Pumpking! Pom!
Welcome back! You've collected them!!
Thank you, pom! We're sorry for putting the curse\non you. We'll remove it right now.\nJacky, Olant, are you guys ready? 3, 2, 1...
Release Trick!!
Now we are invincible!
Let's find out who the witch is at the castle!!
And we'll beat her up!!
Yaaaaahh!!
[ff6464]No! I'm falling! Nooooo!!![ffffff]
It's you! You came again!!
Jacky, Olant and Potumkin aren't here...\nThey were always here though...
Hm? The three buddies? You mean Jacky and others?\nHm, come to think of it, I haven't seen them\nrecently...
Well, they'll come out sooner or later.\nActually, I'd like you to enjoy this place too\ntoday, but...
...Ah, actually, my father is back now...\nLet me explain.
My father travels around the world and brings back\nrare and traditional stuff...
Things in this world are made by mother based on\nthem...
But some of them are dangerous, of course.\nSo, it's a rule to check their safety at father's\nmansion before we bring them in here. But...
This time, it's taking so long and my mother is\nalso worried about it...
Huh? They went to father's mansion...?
I doubt it. Mother told them not to because\nit's dangerous... Well, perhaps, I guess...\nmaybe they didn't... probably...
Agghh! Now that you've said this, I'm so worried!
I'm gonna find them at father's mansion.\nI want you to come with me!
Okay.
Hmm...
Oh, yea?! I knew you'd say so!
Agh, you're so indecisive.\nJust come and think about it later!
Sorry for getting you involved in so many troubles\ntoo this time.
Seems that you play with those kids every time!\nThanks! I appreciate it!
Besides, there seems to be similar and interesting\nstuff too in your world. I might go there one day!
Could you help me when that time comes?!\nI don't care about your answer!
There's no point asking then.\nWhat a helpless guy despite being my husband...
Father, c'mon! The thank you gift.
Thanks for everything! Here's a gift for you!
Phew, somehow we managed to treat the guest well\ntoo this year.
Umm, I'm sorry to have caused you trouble again...
Right! Make sure to learn from this mistake!
Father, you too!
You too!
You were causing the trouble in the first place!!
Oh yeah, I totally forgot! Hahaha!
Jeez......\nWhat a helpless guy, really...
Please forgive me, Zoe.\nI brought us lots of souvenirs from another world,\nyou know.
Y-you think I'd let you off with such stuff......
Of course, I've prepared some stuff for Jeila and\nthe kids too!
For real, Father?!
What?! For us too?
Hooray!
Thanks pom!
Oh well......if that's the case, I'll let you off.\nIt's great that you don't forget about the kids.
Of course. Cuz I'm Zoe's good husband and the good\nfather of Jeila and the kids.
Hihi......that's my love, my dear husband.
Oh, my, I forgot our guest. You saw everything?!
R-relax Zoe!\nW-we just need to, oh right!
Get rid of the witness!!
You need to relax too, dear!!
Seems like father and mother finally calmed down.\nWell, let me greet you once again!
I hope we could meet again.
Yup! I'll bring various interesting stuff from\nanother world again!
Please come again!
We'll always welcome you!
I'll be waiting pom!
Come again next time!\nLooking forward to it!
Oh! You came!\nWelcome!
Pom! Just like Jeila said, you came again pom!
Just like I said right? I knew you'd come back.
Well, I know you're not quite satisfied this time.
Since you've come, let's go see father and mother!
I had great fun this time.\nHey, don't you have any intention of staying here?
Stop that, dear.\nYou're giving him trouble.
It's my first time seeing father fight.\nI didn't expect your ability to be on a par with\nfather's.
The world is really big.\nLet's have a duel again next time!
We've known each other for a long time too.\nLet's meet again when there's a chance!
Yes? What I was making?\nHihihi, after I told Olant and Potumkin that\ntime...
Potumkin and I gathered the stuff we were gonna\nmake...
We combined the things we made and decided to use\nthem for the next Halloween pom!
Hmm, what exactly did you guys make?
Well...
Just...
Wait for it next time...
We're not telling you!!
You guys are so energetic! Aight, see you again!
Oh! Hi there!
You came again!!
Pom? But this lady, it's her first time here,\nisn't it, pom?
Ahh, the pumpkin-like girl! So this is the world\nI've been hearing about. Tee-hee, business chance!\nHi, I'm Pelulu, a merchant! Got any nice stuff?
A new guest! Perfect! We've prepared something new\nto welcome and entertain our guests this year!
It's not free this time, but for demons,\nit's free. So please enjoy it!
Of course it's free for Pelulu, pom!
Really?!\nTee-hee-hee! Nice! Free sounds great!\n...Hm?
Wait! I'm a human!! Not a demon!\nCharge me properly! Not a penny less!!
Anyway, we wish we could welcome you that way,\nbut...
Recently, weird monsters came out and have been\nmessing around here and there...
That's unforgivable, pom! No one else is allowed\nto mess around here but us, pom!!
Yeah, we are busy dealing with those monsters now,\nso see you guys later!
Geez, these stupid kids!!
Mother told us not to act recklessly...! Hm?
Oh, the guest from the other day, you're here!\nAlso, am I seeing a new face?
Well anyway, there's a lot going on right now.\n...First, I want you to come to mother's mansion.
Oh!\nYou guys came at the right time!
Huh?! Don't tell me something is happening\nagain...
Nope, just a bit occupied with Phantom Wisp's\nproblem. Father is researching various things now\nin order to send her back to her world of origin.
Researching about the function, origin, and the\nworld where the item found was bought seems to\ntake some time.
And for the time being!
We're gonna be the Phantom Wisp's coaches!
We're gonna train her again, pom!
Yeah!\nAnd we were just looking for the right partner\nfor her training.
Do I have to do it?
I'm okay with that.
Well, it'd be nice if it's you since you know how\nto go easy on someone. We'll reward you\nproperly...
You should have talked about the reward earlier!\nOf course we'll do it!\nYou won't find anyone better than us!!
Heyyy waittt!!\nWhy did you make such a rash decision...!
Ah, father and mother are also aware of this\nmatter. So it's okay to assume that they will\nreward you individually.
Oh, for real?!\nIf that's the case, you should have told us\nearlier...! Tee-hee
All right then, we're gonna let the Wisp know\nabout this first.
I'm gonna keep a close watch on the match and give\ndirections properly!
If you don't fight properly, I won't forgive you,\npom!
...Wait, what?\nWhy? What exactly is this coaching thing all\nabout?
Those three have been looking forward to taking\ncare of guests this year, but Phantom Wisp\nruined it and they were still mad at her somehow.
So while father is finding a way to send her back\nto the world she belongs to, mother assigned them\nas her coaches to retrain her personality.
You must be wondering why, but according to\nmother, that's one way to make them look and feel\ngreat without actually causing much harm...
In other words, it's to deflect their anger\ntowards Phantom Wisp and at the same time,\nput them back in a good mood.
Maybe that's what mother wants.\nThat's why we were looking for a partner that\nwould understand it.
I'm glad you agree to do it.\nWell, we should head to where Phantom Wisp\nis too!
Gosh, I thought I was gonna make a mint this time!\nBut eventually I'm just getting tangled up in some\nrandom trouble whenever I'm with you!
Oh well, there's nothing we can do this time.
I-I'm sorry.\nAfter I return to my world, I'll try to look for\nsome rare stuff.
What's the point of saying that?\nThat's another world. It's not like we can meet\neasily.
Well, I shoulda known that it was pie in the sky.\nPlus, nothing really surprises me although it's\nanother world...
Hmm? You sure?\nOops, sorry, I forgot I've been in this costume\nall the time.
Huh? What?\nM-Mister Zarth?!\nIs that your true form?!
W-w-waaaitt!! There must be some kind of mistake!!\nThis is the most surprising thing since I came to\nthis world!!
Yeah, it must be.
I won't deny it, that is indeed...
A shocking thing, pom!
S-Should I...\nShould I just stay here a little longer?\nJust kidding.
No way!\nThis guy is mine ♪
My father only belongs to me!
Hahaha! Oh, adventurer!\nAlthough it was different from what I expected,\nI had a lot of fun too this time!
Adventurer, I want you to come again next time!\nYou should come too Pelulu!
Oh, you're here!\nI've been expecting you!
Huh? Are you alone?
The others are preparing something new to welcome\nyou. Anyway, I need your opinion on something.\nC'mon, follow me!
Huff...huff...\nW-what's actually going on here?\nWhat were all those sweets?
Both Olant and Potumkin got eaten by them...
W-what do you mean?!
C-calm down! Um, since their clothes were there,\nI think that means those leftover sweets are their\nbody parts...
What, really?!\nSo those cookies and candies scattered all over\nthe place are their...
Say no more! For now, let's collect as many\ncookies and candies as those that got eaten.
I think we may be able to bring them back by doing\nso...
I'm sorry but Jeila and I will be staying here to\ndo some preparation to bring them back...
So I want you to go into the manor to collect\nthe eaten cookies and candies!
I-I guess we don't have a choice cuz it seems to\nbe an emergency...All right then, but make sure\nyou prepare some rewards for us!
I don't think this would be enough.\nSorry, but please go and collect more!
Good job!\nWe should be fine with this...\nOkay, let me get right to it!
I-I wonder why it's not going well...
Jeila, I know you are trying your best to make it\nwork, but since it's not going so well,\nshouldn't we just ask Zoe for help?
But if mother ever finds out that those two got\neaten...
Seriously? Are you more worried about that now?
Don't worry, if you get scolded, I will too...
F-fine, we've got no choice...\nYou guys wait here for a while.
H-how was it?
We got scolded badly...
Mother told us that some body parts required to\nbring them back are missing.
T-they got eaten?
Zoe said they're still somewhere in the house.\nShe's sure of it.
Does that mean that someone is keeping those\nparts?
Yeah. Mother said that she could feel someone's\nmagic power from the monsters' leftover cookies\nand candies.
She said that there should be a figure that is\nbringing the monsters together.
Based on your story so far, don't tell me...
Yes, exactly!
We want you to find that figure if possible and\nretrieve Olant and Potumkin's vital body parts!
Wait, wait, wait!!\nThere's no reason for us to go that far...
C-c'mon, don't say that!
If you agree to do it, I will ask mother to add\nsomething to your rewards!
What? For real?! A-Ahem...W-well, fine if you\ninsist. Besides, I don't wanna leave you a bad\nimpression by just going gome like this...
T-thank you!
We'll see if we can find another way too!
Okay then, let's go!
Welcome!
